# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-to-late thirties (forty-one as of Volume 5, based on being twenty-eight when brought back11 years prior to Volume 5)  <sub>[v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased (died 13 years prior to Volume 5)  <sub>[v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015), [v4 c32 P21](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds (Glen St. Mary / West farm), Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Former sailor and clerk in his father's store  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Dick was a tall, handsome man with a lean build, high color, and brown hair a shade lighter than his cousin George's. His most distinctive physical feature was his eyes, one being blue and the other hazel. After his death in Cuba, he was mistakenly believed to be his cousin George Moore, who was brought back to Four Winds as a heavily-bearded, overweight, and mentally vacant man.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

In his youth, Dick was handsome and dashing, but possessed a small, ugly soul and a bad temper. He was selfish, obstinate, and given to heavy drinking, often behaving brutally and recklessly. When he wanted something, he pursued it until he got it, only to quickly tire of it. He was notorious for his ill-treatment of those around him, ultimately forcing Leslie West into a bitter marriage through financial coercion.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P31](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0031)_

## History

Dick Moore grew up at Four Winds as the son of Abner Moore. In his youth, he worked in his father's store during the winter and went to sea in the summer. Infatuated with the beautiful Leslie West, he pursued her despite her dislike; when she repeatedly refused him, he coerced her mother into forcing the marriage by threatening to foreclose the mortgage on the West farm. After their marriage, Dick continued his wild ways and quickly grew tired of quiet domestic life. The following spring, he sailed on the vessel Four Sisters to Cuba, where he contracted yellow fever and died shortly after the ship was forced to leave without him. For twelve years, his family and the community of Four Winds mistakenly believed that a brain-injured, amnesiac man brought back by Captain Jim was Dick, until a surgical operation in Montreal restored the man's memory, revealing him to be Dick's double cousin, George Moore.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P25](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0025), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c31 P15](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
